metadata.agent_last_message:
The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Files in `output/`

- **`main.js`** — CLI entry point, argument parsing, orchestration, error/log handling
- **`bib.js`** — `.bib` parser (entries, `@string`, `@preamble`, `@comment`, field concatenation, whitespace compression, crossref resolution with non-transitive inheritance)
- **`bst.js`** — `.bst` lexer/parser (10 top-level commands, identifiers, integer/string/function/quoted-name literals, `%` comments)
- **`vm.js`** — Stack VM with all 37 built-ins, entry/global scope, type checking, sort/iterate/reverse/execute commands, structured warnings
- **`names.js`** — Author-name list splitting (`and`-separated), tokenization with `~`/`-` separators, parts decomposition for 0/1/2 commas, `format.name$` with discretionary tie handling
- **`output.js`** — Output buffer with bibtex.web's two-phase 79-column wrap (backward to col 3, then forward fallback), 2-space continuation indent
- **`strops.js`** — `purify$`/`change.case$`/`text.length$`/`text.prefix$`/`width$` with brace and special-character (`{\AA}` etc.) handling, cmr10 width table (`a=500`, `M=917`, etc.)

## Features

- Run via `node main.js --bib <path> --style <path> --cites <path>|--aux <path> --output <path> [--log <path>]`
- `.bbl` output uses LF line endings, UTF-8, correct line wrapping
- Structured JSON log with all required keys
- Error JSON for parse/runtime failures (`source: bib|bst|runtime`)
- Warnings for `unresolved_macro`, `unresolved_crossref`, `crossref_cycle`, `duplicate_key`, `bst_type_error`, `bst_undefined_function`
- Exit codes: 0 success, 1 on parse/load/runtime errors, 2 on internal errors
- Tested against all four canonical styles (`plain`, `alpha`, `unsrt`, `abbrv`) with multi-author entries, crossref, accents, hyphens, ties, and `@string` macros

    def run_bibtex(
        command: tuple[str, ...],
        bib_text: str,
        style_text: str,
        cites: list[str] | str,
        tmp_path: Path,
        *,
        timeout: int = 30,
